tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Newest-first headlines from worldwide sources, optionally filtered by words, language, country, topic, source, kind and time.

country.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the publisher's country, e.g. "US,GB"

source.description: Comma-separated source ids (see list_sources) or publisher domains

kind.description: Comma-separated: article, press_release, official, community, research, sponsored

category.description: Comma-separated IPTC top-level categories: arts-culture-entertainment, conflict-war, crime-law, disaster-accident, economy-business, education, environment, health, human-interest, labour, lifestyle-leisure, politics, religion, science-technology, society, sport, weather

political.description: true: political stories only (political score ≥ 0.5); false: non-political only

tone_min.description: Only items with tone ≥ this (-1 most negative … 1 most positive)

since.description: Only items published at/after this: RFC 3339, a date, or an age like "6h", "2d"

sponsored.description: Paid press releases are labeled; exclude to omit them

format.description: md: readable with summaries; lines: tab-separated, fewest tokens; ndjson/json: full records

q.description: What you're looking for, in any language. Matches by keyword over the last 7 days unless since is given, and by meaning over headlines from the last 2 days (hybrid); results carry a relevance score.

match.description: keyword: exact words only; semantic: meaning only (cross-language)

collapse.description: One item per story (best representative); related = other reports of it

sort.description: hot: most widely covered stories of the last 48h, one per story; positive/negative: most positive/negative tone first (last 24h unless since is given)

before.description: Paging cursor from a previous result's next link

tools.name: sync_news
tools.description: Incremental feed: returns items added after `after`, oldest first, plus a new cursor. Call again with that cursor to get only what is new.

country.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the publisher's country, e.g. "US,GB"

source.description: Comma-separated source ids (see list_sources) or publisher domains

kind.description: Comma-separated: article, press_release, official, community, research, sponsored

category.description: Comma-separated IPTC top-level categories: arts-culture-entertainment, conflict-war, crime-law, disaster-accident, economy-business, education, environment, health, human-interest, labour, lifestyle-leisure, politics, religion, science-technology, society, sport, weather

political.description: true: political stories only (political score ≥ 0.5); false: non-political only

tone_min.description: Only items with tone ≥ this (-1 most negative … 1 most positive)

since.description: Only items published at/after this: RFC 3339, a date, or an age like "6h", "2d"

sponsored.description: Paid press releases are labeled; exclude to omit them

format.description: md: readable with summaries; lines: tab-separated, fewest tokens; ndjson/json: full records

after.description: The cursor returned by your previous sync_news call; 0 to start from the oldest retained item

tools.name: list_stories
tools.description: The most widely covered stories right now (last 48h), each with a neutral multi-source brief when available, outlet count, languages, entities and a representative report. Filter by lang, country, category, entity.

tools.name: find_entities
tools.description: Look up Wikidata ids for a name (e.g. "Tesla", "Lagos") with how many items mention each in the last 7 days; pass the id as `entity` to search_news or list_stories.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Every item in a story (the `story` id on items, st_…): all outlets and languages covering the same event, newest first.

tools.name: find_prospects
tools.description: The companies and people in an article or a story, ready to add to CRM by Hottub. Each has add_url (CRM by Hottub's add form, filled in; the person presses Add) and propose (arguments for CRM by Hottub's propose_relationship tool, which an owner approves). Give item (n_… or s_…) or story (st_…); or q to gather the organizations and people named across recent news on a subject, most often named first.

item.description: An item id from search_news or get_story

q.description: A subject, in any language, e.g. "battery factory expansion"

kind.description: With q: only organizations, or only people

since.description: With q: RFC 3339, a date, or an age like "3d" (default 7d)

tools.name: get_news_item
tools.description: Full record for one item id (n_… for news, s_… for sponsored).

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Registered sources with their language, country, kind and health. Filter by q (name), country or lang.

tools.name: quote_placement
tools.description: Quote for placing a labeled, paid press release in the News by Hottub mix via Hottub Business. Price varies by topic tier, current topic interest, demand, targeting reach and duration; the response itemizes each factor. Country targeting also places it in that country's list on the news map (one paid slot, after the fourth story). Read-only: returns a price; books and charges nothing.

topics.description: Comma-separated topics to target, e.g. "ai,business"; omit for run of network

tools.name: newsmap
tools.description: What the news covered in a period, for the world or a region: reports counted by publisher country (a choropleth map, as links to SVG and PNG) and the most widely covered stories with outlet counts. Periods: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC day), YYYY-wWW (ISO week), YYYY-MM, or today, yesterday, this-week, last-week, this-month, last-month. Past periods are final and permanent.

period.description: 2026-10-17, 2026-w42, 2026-10, today, yesterday, this-week, last-week, this-month or last-month

tools.name: live_map
tools.description: The last 24 hours, country by country, like an election map: each country's leading story (the one the most of its own outlets covered), the stories leading in the most countries, and countries too quiet to call. Give country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) for that country's stories: sort popular (its outlets), cited (stories that broke there, by how far outlets elsewhere picked them up) or relevant (what it covers more than the rest of the world). A country's list may carry one labeled paid placement.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "DE"; omit for the whole map

tools.name: news_stats
tools.description: Item counts over the last 24 hours by kind, language, country and source, plus the current sync cursor.
